hero.headline: Architecting the Future of African AI
hero.subheadline: We are looking for bold thinkers and expert doers to help us build and operate the continent's most efficient AI compute facility.

sections.title: Join a Mission-Driven Team
sections.body: At Kenya AI Compute, you won't just be maintaining servers; you'll be building the foundation for an entire continent's digital future. Our team is a unique blend of international expertise and local talent, united by the goal of democratizing access to high-performance computing. We offer a high-growth environment where technical excellence and innovative problem-solving are rewarded. Whether you are a data center engineer specializing in high-density cooling or a financial analyst with a passion for DePIN tokenomics, we provide a platform for you to do your best work and leave a lasting impact on the global AI landscape. We value diversity, radical transparency, and the courage to challenge the status quo of the infrastructure industry. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. sections.title: Why Work Here?
items: Impact: Build infrastructure that powers the world's most advanced AI models.
Equity: Opportunity to participate in an ESOP for key technical and management roles.
Flexibility: Remote-friendly roles combined with a cutting-edge hub in Nairobi.
Growth: Fast-tracked career progression as we scale from 1MW to 3MW+.
Innovation: Work at the cutting edge of DePIN, Green Energy, and HPC.

sections.copy: We are always looking for exceptional talent. Submit a general application and we'll reach out when we have a match.
